status: REGISTERED, NOT RUN. Committed before the first E26 residential-link round per PS-06-D1.
title: Does Top-1% DCT + EF21 outer-gradient and adapter compression inside the PS-01-fixed BOINC MoE chain reduce wire bytes per round across at least 5 residential links without degrading held-out bits-per-byte beyond the registered non-inferiority margin?

design.unit_of_comparison: Paired outer rounds on the same PS-01-fixed Granite-1B-A400M base chain and deterministic domain sequence (general, french, edu_web, news, biomed, math), measured across at least 5 distinct residential internet links with recorded upload/download Mbps and RTT ms.

C0_uncompressed_control.compressor: none (raw fp16/bf16 LoRA adapter delta safetensors)
C0_uncompressed_control.chain: PS-01-fixed BOINC MoE chain (ibm-granite/granite-3.1-1b-a400m-base, rank 8, alpha 16, seq 128, micro-batch 2)

C1_top1pct_dct_ef21.compressor: hivemind.compress.dct_ef21.compress_top1pct_dct_ef21 (Top-1% DCT coefficients with EF21 residual buffer)
C1_top1pct_dct_ef21.error_feedback: EF21 per-worker state persisted across consecutive rounds
C1_top1pct_dct_ef21.chain: PS-01-fixed BOINC MoE chain (identical data shards, seeds, and hyperparameters as C0_uncompressed_control)

metrics.M1_wire_bytes_per_round: Total serialized payload bytes uploaded and downloaded per round on each residential link.
metrics.M3_upload_wall_time_s: Measured upload wall-clock duration in seconds on each residential link (with link up_mbps, down_mbps, and rtt_ms recorded).
metrics.M4_held_out_bpb_delta: Held-out bits-per-byte change over the 384 fixed evaluation spans (64 spans x 6 domains): bpb_end(C1) - bpb_end(C0).

hypotheses.H1_bandwidth_reduction: Median wire-byte compression ratio M2 >= 50.0x across the registered rounds.
hypotheses.H2_loss_non_inferiority: Pooled held-out bits-per-byte of C1_top1pct_dct_ef21 is not worse than C0_uncompressed_control by more than the registered margin delta_bpb_max = +0.010 bpb, andhivemind.swarm.verified_update_gate.decide returns ACCEPT under UpdatePolicy(alpha=0.05, min_n=30, tolerated_net_loss=0, require_improvement=False).

acceptance_rules_fixed_now.R1_link_diversity: At least 5 distinct residential links with recorded up_mbps, down_mbps, rtt_ms, and zero inbound ports.

verdicts.QUALITY_REGRESSION: R1 and R2 hold, R3 fails
verdicts.INVALID: R1 fails (fewer than 5 links or missing link telemetry)

controls.positive_control: C0_uncompressed_control run on the exact same shard sequence and RNG seeds.
controls.negative_control: Zeroed or random-index 1% sparse payload without EF21 error feedback must fail R3_quality on the same shard sequence.

not_claimed: No E26 residential link round has been executed in this pre-registration file.
Simulation compression ratios from earlier paper sections are not substituted for residential link measurements.
